positions.name: PallasineChecklistStandard
positions.frame: what does the Pallasine onboarding checklist cover and how did it become the standing procedure?
positions.why: Both expressions read in the same direction: src-1 names the checklist's mandatory contents and first-week timing as an established universal rule, while src-2 grounds its institutional provenance by noting it superseded the old wiki page last quarter. Together they answer what the checklist is and how it came to be the standard, held under a shared calm-positive, authority-ranking, conservation-and-competence register.
